items.title: Register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.
items.computation: The letter was handed over in person on Wed 18.11.2026 (actual receipt, no delivery fiction needed). The employment ends 31.01.2027, i.e. about 74 days / ~2.4 months after notification – less than the 3 months required by § 38 Abs. 1 SGB III. Because less than 3 months remain, the law requires the jobseeking registration within 3 days of becoming aware of the end date (not 3 months before it). Counting from 18.11.2026 (day of event not counted, § 187 Abs.1 BGB): day 1 = Thu 19.11, day 2 = Fri 20.11, day 3 = Sat 21.11.2026. Since the 3rd day is a Saturday and the Agentur für Arbeit is closed, the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 23.11.2026.

items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage (unfair-dismissal lawsuit) at the Labour Court
items.quote: Zu Ihrer Information: Eine Klage gegen diese Kündigung wäre innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Erhalt des Schreibens beim Arbeitsgericht einzureichen.
items.computation: Receipt (Zugang) occurred by personal hand-delivery on Wed 18.11.2026, witnessed by Mr Exempelwinzer, so no delivery fiction is needed and the receipt day is certain. Per § 4 KSchG the 3-week period for a Kündigungsschutzklage runs from receipt; under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted, and for weeks the period ends on the same weekday n weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 18.11.2026 (Wed) + 3 weeks = 09.12.2026 (Wed). 09.12.2026 is a normal working day (no public holiday in RP), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

items.title: Last day of employment
items.quote: Wir kündigen deshalb das Arbeitsverhältnis ordentlich unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Frist zum 31.01.2027.
items.computation: Calendar date given explicitly in the letter as the end of the employment relationship; used as written.

warnings: The statutory 3-day deadline to register as jobseeking with the Agentur für Arbeit (calculated as 23.11.2026) has already passed as of today (24.11.2026); the person should contact the Agentur für Arbeit immediately and explain the delay to minimise any reduction of Arbeitslosengeld.
